name: wp-instant-monorepo
description: WP Instant (SpeedForge Engine) - High-Performance Zero-DNS WordPress Optimization SaaS & Client

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@wpinstant/shared && npm run build:worker --workspace=@wpinstant/saas-app && npm run build --workspace=@wpinstant/edge-api
scripts.build:saas: npm run build --workspace=@wpinstant/shared && npm run build:worker --workspace=@wpinstant/saas-app
scripts.build:edge: npm run build --workspace=@wpinstant/shared && npm run build --workspace=@wpinstant/edge-api
